title: Doozy Vape Co Doozy Legends Liquid Gold 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Liquid Gold from the Doozy Vapes Co. Legends collection is a sublime dessert concoction that hits your palates in rich, comforting waves. Decadent pastry slathered in fragrant, silky vanilla custard with a dollop of cream for good measure. Bliss. This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle really helps your favourite e-liquid go the distance and comes with 25ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. This e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , vape mod kits and sub-ohm tanks .
